{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the revenue column: check for thousands separators
print("First 5 values of revenue:")
print(sales['revenue'].head(5))

# Check for the presence of commas
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()
print(f"\nDoes revenue contain commas? {has_commas}")

# Check for the internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
print(f"\nNumber of rows with revenue = 999999.99: {len(sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99'])}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"\nNumber of refunded orders: {len(sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded'])}")"}
